free_tier.notes: the Free Plan Limits tab lists 10 model rows, each printed per model id as RPM, RPD, TPM, TPD, ASH and ASD; K means thousands, so 1K is 1,000 and 200K is 200,000. The Developer Plan Limits tab is a separate table

identity_cost.detail: one form, Create Account or Login, serves both sign-up and login with Google, GitHub, SSO and email; the served auth config lists only OAuth (Google, GitHub), SSO and email magic links, so the email route is a magic link and there is no password and no SMS method. The sign-up request carries only the session token and an optional referral code, with a Stytch device telemetry ID header: no phone number and no card. A payment method (credit card, US bank account or SEPA debit account) is required only to upgrade from the Free tier to the Developer tier. Creating an API key requires a Cloudflare Turnstile token.
